sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders are looking to bounce back after their most recent loss, though their underlying form remains strong with seven wins in their last six outings before that setback. Alsager Town arrive in poor form and at the foot of the division with just four points from ten games, making this a favourable fixture for Sandbach to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Stafford Town (second, 20 points) travel to Dawley Town in a match with title-race implications as they chase Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between third and fifth; Bridgnorth have won four straight before two recent losses, while Eccleshall are on a strong run. Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth) visit Wednesfield Community in a midweek replay on Wednesday. Bilston Town, currently sixth with solid form, face Foley Meir at home. In-form Barnton (15 points, four wins in their last five) host struggling Shawbury United, who have lost their last six. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement battle between two of the division's weakest performers. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a mid-table encounter. Brereton Social, winless in four recent games, entertain Widnes Town, who remain pointless and goalless in recent fixtures. Crewe host Allscott Heath in another match at the lower end of the table.
